description: This file defines a static utility class 'BitStreamFormatter' for formatting encoded bitstreams into a human-readable textual representation, primarily used for debugging or analysis within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

classes.name: BitStreamFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to format encoded bitstreams into a human-readable string for debugging and analysis.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the provided reader into a string representation.

methods.name: Format(PooledBuffer.BufferSlice, SerializerSession)
methods.description: Creates a reader from a buffer slice and formats it into a string.

methods.name: Format(byte[], SerializerSession)
methods.description: Creates a reader from a byte array and formats it into a string.

methods.name: Format(ReadOnlySpan<byte>, SerializerSession)
methods.description: Creates a reader from a ReadOnlySpan<byte> and formats it into a string.

methods.name: Format(ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, SerializerSession)
methods.description: Creates a reader from a ReadOnlyMemory<byte> and formats it into a string.

methods.name: Format(ReadOnlySequence<byte>, SerializerSession)
methods.description: Creates a reader from a ReadOnlySequence<byte> and formats it into a string.

methods.name: Format(Stream, SerializerSession)
methods.description: Creates a reader from a Stream and formats it into a string.

methods.name: Format(ref Reader<TInput>, StringBuilder)
methods.description: Formats a reader into a StringBuilder, used internally for detailed formatting.

methods.name: FormatField
methods.description: Formats a specific field from the reader, handling different wire types and nested structures.

methods.name: FormatByteArray
methods.description: Formats a byte array as ASCII characters if possible, otherwise as hex values.

methods.name: FormatFieldHeader
methods.description: Formats the header information of a field, including type, id, schema, and extended type.

methods.name: FormatTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Recursively formats a tag-delimited field, handling nested fields and end markers.

methods.name: AppendAddress
methods.description: Appends the current reader position as a hexadecimal address to the StringBuilder.
